title: Aureline M5 execution-evidence causality matrix
description: Canonical, export-safe object model that freezes the M5 Problems / output-channel / execution-evidence causality matrix into one packet. Each row is a claimed (or Labs) tooling causality lane that binds a problem record, output channel, execution-evidence projection, or evidence-bundle export to its origin run/step/provider/channel/build-toolchain/host-target identity, its problem-source kind (structured vs heuristic vs imported-provider), its confidence tier, its evidence freshness / stale / superseded state, and its reopen-to-origin target. Structured and heuristic origins stay distinct; large logs stay stream-first, searchable, and exportable; and support, AI, review, and pipeline overlays never flatten away the original run/channel/artifact lineage. The same row vocabulary describes local, remote, notebook, extension-owned, AI-triggered, headless, pipeline/provider, and imported evidence paths without erasing adapter-specific detail. Downstream Problems, output, diagnostics, AI evidence, support-export, review, and docs surfaces ingest this packet rather than inventing a parallel causal model. Adding an enum value is additive-minor and requires a schema_version bump; repurposing an existing value is breaking and requires a new decision row.

redaction_class_token.description: Default redaction posture for the packet. No raw stdout/stderr bytes, command lines, provider log bodies, env bodies, absolute paths, URLs, or secrets ever cross this boundary.

surface_family.description: Which Problems/output/execution-evidence surface family this lane primarily backs. All four share one causal vocabulary.

claim_posture.description: Whether the lane is publicly claimed. Labs/unadvertised lanes make no causal-authority claim and are never widened.

origin_class.description: How the run/evidence originated. First-party local/notebook/headless/extension/AI origins can claim a full local causal chain; remote, pipeline/provider, and imported origins are read-only overlays that never claim live local authority.

problem_source_kind.description: Appendix BI.1 problem-source class. Heuristic output parsing requires an explicit confidence tier and a raw-output backlink; structured and heuristic origins stay distinct.

output_channel_class.description: Appendix BI.2 output-channel/evidence class. Canonical channel names stay stable across UI, CLI, export, and support; no anonymous hidden channels.

confidence_tier.description: Confidence taxonomy. Structured fields are full confidence; heuristic parses carry an explicit tier; imported provider mappings carry their mapping quality; unmapped is a first-class state, not an invisible gap.

freshness_state.description: The evidence projection's own freshness/anchoring state. Stale and superseded states must remain visible wherever the evidence is rendered.

reopen_target.description: Where reopen-to-origin lands. The canonical evidence must stay reopenable; none_keyboard_fallback means lineage could not be reconstructed and only a raw/keyboard fallback remains.

proof_currency.description: Currency of the certification proof that this lane preserves the causal chain (distinct from the evidence's own freshness_state).

identity.description: Stable identifiers binding the lane to its execution context, run/step, provider, channel, build/toolchain, host/target, task-event envelope, problem record, and evidence bundle. Lineage is reconstructed from these refs, never inferred from freeform display text.

causal_chain.description: The causal-chain invariants every lane must keep true to certify. Each maps to a guardrail in TDD §7.6.14: structured/heuristic distinct, raw backlink on heuristic, origin adapter preserved, run/step/provider/channel preserved, build/toolchain/host/target preserved, confidence labelled, logs stream-first/searchable/exportable, overlays never flatten lineage, superseded state marked, imported overlays stay read-only.

export_packet.description: Minimum evidence-bundle export identity (Appendix BI.2 / §9.20). A bundle must be attributable and reopenable without the original UI state or a live provider session.

allOf.description: Provider, pipeline, remote, and imported origins must carry a provider ref so the read-only overlay can name its source.
